setup_findings: Previous interrupted work was building the GeoNames/Gazetteer DUUI-Py image; TaxoNERD was not installed locally.
The gazetteer backend serves POST /v1/process; using the root URL returns 404, so evaluation pins backend_url to /v1/process.
The full default BioFID config was started but was still loading after the short demo window; measured configs use small fast resource subsets.

plain-de.backend_config: fast plain German vernacular config in /tmp/gazetteer-fast-plain-de.toml
